div.head: Hn 59.2a
div.ab: Pridie ante solis occasum ad domum suam, si residens est cum quo agitur — et per bonum testimonium uicinorum et aliorum, quos secum habeat qui placitum contramandat —, ipsi respectetur, si domi est; uxori, dapifero uel preposito et familie eius dicatur intelligibiliter, si idem abfuerit. Et hoc utrimque tercio licet, continue siue interrupte.

div.ab: On the day before, before sunset, at his house, if the man proceeded against is resident [there] — and with the good testimony of neighbours and others, whom he who countermands the plea should have with him —, let it be respited to him himself, if he is at home; let it be said intelligibly to his wife, steward or reeve and his household, if he himself is absent. And this is permitted on either side three times, consecutively or with intervals.
